reasoning_content:
The api container starts but vendor not installed (composer install not yet run). The api container's entrypoint runs before composer install. That's expected — the guide says to run composer install in tooling. The api container will need restart after composer install. Let me now do the API setup steps in the tooling container.

Let me run composer install in the tooling container. Note the tooling container mounts ./ at /var/www/html, so /var/www/html/api is the api dir.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T tooling bash -lc 'cd api && composer install --no-interaction 2>&1 | tail -20'
